note: Source of truth for the UI surface inventory. Render with: python3 scripts/design/render_surfaces.py. Phases and statuses are derived from docs/product/catalog/features.json and are never written here.

zones.title: Installer, first run and OS integration

surfaces.name: Horizontal tab strip
surfaces.notes: Default layout. Adds a visible suspended state and the Brumel colour mixer; no new layout code in Internal Alpha.

surfaces.name: Vertical tab sidebar
surfaces.notes: Builds on upstream vertical tabs; trees, folders and archive come later.

surfaces.name: Toolbar and omnibox
surfaces.notes: Security indicator stays upstream and is never themed by custom CSS.

surfaces.name: Omnibox suggestions and Universal Search
surfaces.notes: Extra result groups (open tabs, archive, settings) on the existing popup.

surfaces.name: Command palette
surfaces.notes: Open question: native popup or a WebUI bubble hosted in Views.

surfaces.name: App menu
surfaces.notes: Remove Google entries, add Brumel entries behind progressive disclosure.

surfaces.name: Clean Web button and per-site panel
surfaces.notes: Counts only what was really blocked on this page; per-site toggle.

surfaces.name: Page info and site permissions bubble
surfaces.notes: Security surface: restyle only through the colour mixer.

surfaces.name: Performance profile control
surfaces.notes: Hidden by default; reachable from the menu and the palette.

surfaces.name: Downloads bubble
surfaces.notes: Dangerous-file warnings keep upstream wording and layout.

surfaces.name: Side panel host
surfaces.notes: Bookmarks, reading queue, web panels and highlights share one host.

surfaces.name: Split view
surfaces.notes: Extends upstream split view.

surfaces.name: Media and audio panel
surfaces.notes: Extends the upstream global media controls.

surfaces.name: Bookmarks bar
surfaces.notes: Hidden by default as upstream.

surfaces.name: Infobars and toasts (undo, restore, update, crash recovery)
surfaces.notes: One quiet toast pattern; every destructive action offers undo.

surfaces.name: Floating link preview and Link Inspector
Private, guest and temporary identity windows
surfaces.notes: Must stay unmistakable from a normal window.

surfaces.name: Credential and autofill bubbles
surfaces.notes: Security surface: restyle only through the colour mixer.

surfaces.name: New Tab page
surfaces.notes: Replaces the upstream page, which depends on Google services.

surfaces.name: Settings: shell, search and navigation
surfaces.notes: Chromium settings (Polymer/Lit) with Brumel sections added.

surfaces.name: Settings: Performance
surfaces.notes: Extends upstream Performance settings.

surfaces.name: Settings: Privacy and security
surfaces.notes: Secure DNS default and HTTPS-Only live here from Technical Foundation.

surfaces.name: Settings: Profiles and local mode
surfaces.notes: Replaces the Google account card with a local profile card.

surfaces.name: Settings: Passwords and autofill
surfaces.notes: Upstream password manager page, branded.

surfaces.name: Settings: Brumel Nano
surfaces.notes: Off until enabled; shows models, size and where data goes.

surfaces.name: Settings: Connect and sync
surfaces.notes: Replaces Google sync settings.

surfaces.name: Settings: Backups, settings history and reset
About Brumel and updates
surfaces.notes: Version, channel, update state, licences.

surfaces.name: Brumel module page (chrome://brumel)
surfaces.notes: First Brumel WebUI page: lists registered modules and their state.

surfaces.name: Resource monitor
surfaces.notes: Upstream task manager is native Views; open question whether Brumel's monitor is a WebUI page.

surfaces.name: Glass Box (brumel://glass-box)
surfaces.notes: Every connection the browser itself makes, and the telemetry preview.

surfaces.name: Migration Assistant
surfaces.notes: Extends the upstream import dialog.

surfaces.name: Rules editor
surfaces.notes: One editor shared by every rule-based feature.

surfaces.name: Web App Dock
surfaces.notes: Extends chrome://apps.

surfaces.name: Reader view
surfaces.notes: Upstream reading mode lives in the side panel.

surfaces.name: Private window New Tab page
surfaces.notes: States plainly what private mode does and does not protect.

surfaces.name: Security interstitials
surfaces.notes: Security surface: upstream layout and wording; branding only.

surfaces.name: Profile picker
surfaces.notes: No Google sign-in card.

surfaces.name: Permission prompts
surfaces.notes: Security surface: upstream layout; adds 'this visit only'.

surfaces.name: Print preview
surfaces.notes: Branding only.

surfaces.name: OS authentication lock
surfaces.notes: Uses the OS prompt (Windows Hello, polkit); Brumel only frames it.

surfaces.name: Selection actions menu
surfaces.notes: Extends the context menu.

surfaces.name: Media overlays (cinema, captions, recording)
surfaces.notes: Recording must always show a visible indicator.

surfaces.name: Guaranteed Exit overlay
surfaces.notes: Drawn by the browser above web content; pages cannot style or cover it.

surfaces.name: Windows installer
surfaces.notes: Open question: Chromium's mini_installer shows almost no UI. Keep it silent and rely on first run, or add an installer window.

surfaces.name: Windows uninstall dialog
surfaces.notes: Offers to keep or delete local data, with no retention prompts.

surfaces.name: App icon, taskbar and desktop entries
surfaces.notes: Blocked on the final logo; icon set is pending.

surfaces.name: First-run welcome
surfaces.notes: No account, no sign-in. Three steps at most: look, import, done.

surfaces.name: First-run import step
surfaces.notes: Full Migration Assistant arrives in Public Alpha.

surfaces.name: Default browser prompt
surfaces.notes: Upstream infobar. Asked once at first run, never repeated (UI-019 acceptance).
